'''Complete Breakfast''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Complete Breakfast may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Complete Breakfast per year on [[Alex]]'s birthday, [[Summer|Summer 13]]. Five Complete Breakfasts are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|home cook|24|y}}. One Complete Breakfast may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. 

In total ingredients, cooking a Complete Breakfast from scratch requires 2 [[Egg]]s, 1 [[Oil]], 1 [[Wheat Flour]], 1 [[Potato]], and 1 [[Milk]].

==Bundles==
Complete Breakfast is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Complete Breakfast is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Complete Breakfast is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt000|link=Tailoring{{!}}Classic Overalls|class=inline}}. It is a yellow dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the yellow dye pot at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]], for use in [[dyeing]].
